source.evidence: (R) Local enemy behaviour: the melee values are this build's original constants; the skittish cycle is the owner's 2026-10-15 design for the Troll Summoner (Research/Owner Field Notes); no original server AI parameters are recovered.

melee.note: (R) Chase and swing; the build's original enemy constants. The default for enemies without a behaviour.

skittish.note: (R) Troll Summoner, the owner's design 2026-10-15: fights beside its summoned minions; alone it runs 4 s (slower than a running player), rests 3 s playing com_stunned (the window to hit it), then runs again, within 12 m of its spawn.

stationary.note: (R) Never moves; swings at players within reach. For turrets, totems and guards that hold a doorway.
